result.quote: Indeed, he himself hurried to get out, because the LORD had afflicted him.
result.reason: The key is explicitly supported, but “Why” is ambiguous. The passage also supports the materially different explanation that Uzziah was afflicted because he acted unfaithfully by trying to offer incense despite the priests’ warning. The question should specify whether it asks who afflicted him or what wrongdoing led to the affliction.
